analytics.entry: Entry page (first page of the session)
analytics.footnote: Days are UTC. Visitor ids change every day, so over several days unique visitors is the sum of daily uniques. Visitors sending Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control, bots and admin sessions are not counted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What data demircucu.com collects, why, and for how long.
privacy.intro: This page explains which data is processed when you visit demircucu.com. The site is a personal portfolio and blog; it shows no ads, sells no data and uses no third-party analytics or tracking services.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller for personal data on this site is Demir Cücü. For questions about this policy or your data, use the form on the contact page.

analytics.title: Visit statistics
analytics.body: To see which pages are read, visits are counted on our own server without cookies. No cookie or similar identifier is stored in your browser. When you open a page, the following is recorded:
items: The address of the page and the site language (Turkish / English)
The domain of the site that referred you (for example google.com, not the full address) and utm campaign parameters if the link has them
Country (a country code the hosting provider derives from your IP address; the IP address itself is not stored)
Device type and the names of your browser and operating system (from the User-Agent your browser sends)
Time spent on the page, how far it was scrolled, and clicks on external links on project pages

A daily visitor code: your IP address and User-Agent are hashed one way (SHA-256) together with a random value that exists for that day only. The random value is deleted when the day ends, so the code does not identify you and visits on different days cannot be linked.

notCollected.title: What is not recorded
notCollected.body: If your browser sends a Do Not Track (DNT) or Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, your visit is not recorded at all. Search engine bots and similar automated clients are not counted either.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Visit statistics use no cookies. The site uses only these cookies, which are necessary for it to work:
items: NEXT_LOCALE: a necessary cookie used only to remember your language preference ("tr" or "en"); it holds nothing else and is not used for tracking.
Session cookies: only if you sign in, to keep you signed in.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Individual page views are kept for 90 days and then deleted. Daily totals derived from them (for example how often a post was read on a day) are kept indefinitely; these totals contain no personal information.

accounts.title: Accounts, comments and the contact form
accounts.body: If you create an account, your e-mail address and name, your comments and your likes are stored. The name, e-mail address and message you send through the contact form are stored so that you can be answered.

processors.title: Service providers and international transfer
processors.body: Your data is processed and stored outside Türkiye. The site runs on the infrastructure of Vercel Inc., based in the United States; the database, sign-in and files are stored with Supabase in the Seoul region of South Korea. These providers process the data only to provide the service.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: To exercise your rights under the KVKK and the GDPR (access, correction, deletion of your data) or to ask about this policy, use the form on the contact page. Visit statistics do not identify you and therefore cannot be traced to one person; account and message data is deleted on request.
